_comment: Machine-readable sidecar for export-size-spree.md (AC-REL-2). scripts/verify-export-size.py: (1) asserts repo.pinned_sha against its own hardcoded, frozen constant (never the reverse -- same discipline as scripts/verify-probe-verdict.py's bar/repo-set checks); (2) recomputes the verdict as export_bytes <= ceiling_bytes in pure Python, never trusting the recorded verdict label as printed; (3) rejects a mismatch between the recorded verdict and the mechanical evaluation in EITHER direction. Measured once at P3/release-prep (owner vivi, per plan-state.json V4), matching the AC-A3-1 measure-once-and-record pattern -- CI asserts this recorded number, it never re-clones or re-indexes Spree per PR.
